title: Panel threshold regression with unobserved individual-specific threshold effects
title_zh: 具有未观测个体特定阈值效应的面板阈值回归
title_primary: 具有未观测个体特定阈值效应的面板阈值回归
title_secondary: Panel threshold regression with unobserved individual-specific threshold effects
authors: Ping Yu, Shengjie Hong, Peter C.B. Phillips
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper provides a new approach to estimation and inference in multiple regime panel threshold regression with unobserved individual-specific threshold effects. Such effects are practically relevant and have features that distinguish them from traditional linear panel data models. It is shown that within-regime demeaning in the static model or within-regime first-differencing in the dynamic model both fail to deliver consistent threshold estimators. Instead, correlated random effects models are suggested to address endogeneity in such panel threshold systems. The paper develops a unified framework of estimation and inference for both static and dynamic models that applies irrespective of whether the unobserved individual-specific threshold effects exist or whether the number of regimes is correctly specified. The approach involves model selection based on sequential testing which allows for underestimation of the number of regimes, develops asymptotic theory for least squares estimation that is robust to such model misspecification, and proposes new inferential methods for the model parameters which have improved asymptotic and empirical properties over existing methods. Simulations combined with an empirical application illustrate the practical utility of the new methodology.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于估计和推断具有未观测个体特定阈值效应的多机制面板阈值回归的新方法。此类效应在现实中具有相关性，并具有使其区别于传统线性面板数据模型的特征。研究表明，静态模型中的机制内去均值以及动态模型中的机制内一阶差分均无法得到一致的阈值估计量。为此，本文建议采用相关随机效应模型来处理此类面板阈值系统中的内生性。本文为静态模型和动态模型建立了一个统一的估计与推断框架，该框架无论未观测个体特定阈值效应是否存在，或机制数量是否被正确设定，均可适用。该方法涉及基于序贯检验的模型选择，允许机制数量被低估；建立了对此类模型误设定具有稳健性的最小二乘估计渐近理论；并针对模型参数提出了新的推断方法，这些方法在渐近性质和有限样本经验性质上均优于现有方法。模拟结合一项实证应用说明了该新方法的实际效用。

title: News Consumption in the Digital Age
title_zh: 数字时代的新闻消费
title_primary: 数字时代的新闻消费
title_secondary: News Consumption in the Digital Age
authors: Francesco Capozza, Ingar Haaland, Christopher Roth, Johannes Wohlfart
official: 官方在线 2026-08-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Digital technologies have transformed the news landscape, shifting consumption from print media toward online providers. This has allowed news outlets to collect richer data on individual readers, and to use those data both to tailor the news a reader sees— which stories appear and how they are framed—and to sell more precisely targeted advertising. Online news outlets also increasingly recruit readers from social media, amplifying incentives to capture reader attention through sensationalized stories and other techniques to increase engagement. Generative AI is likely to accelerate this trend by lowering the cost of personalizing news. Whether cheaper production and finer personalization raise or lower consumer welfare depends on how closely the objectives firms maximize are aligned with the underlying preferences of consumers. This review studies how the shift toward online news consumption affects both the supply and the demand for news and draws potential implications for consumer welfare.
abstract_zh: 数字技术已深刻改变了新闻业的格局，将消费从纸质媒体转向在线提供商。这使得新闻机构能够收集关于个体读者的更丰富数据，并利用这些数据既定制读者所见的新闻——包括哪些报道出现及其呈现方式——又销售更精准定向的广告。在线新闻提供商还日益从社交媒体吸引读者，这加剧了通过耸人听闻的报道及其他提升参与度的技巧来捕捉读者注意力的激励。生成式人工智能可能通过降低新闻个性化成本而加速这一趋势。更廉价的生产与更精细的个性化是提升还是降低消费者福利，取决于企业所最大化的目标与消费者潜在偏好的契合程度。本综述考察了向在线新闻消费的转变如何影响新闻的供给与需求，并探讨其对消费者福利的潜在影响。

title: DP13063 Location as an Asset
title_zh: 区位作为资产
title_primary: 区位作为资产
title_secondary: DP13063 Location as an Asset
authors: Adrien Bilal, Esteban Rossi-Hansberg
official: 官方在线 2018-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The location of individuals determines their job opportunities, living amenities, and housing costs. We argue that it is useful to conceptualize the location choice of individuals as a decision to invest in a `location asset'. This asset has a cost equal to the location's rent, and a payoff through better job opportunities and, potentially, more human capital for the individual and her children. As with any asset, savers in the location asset transfer resources into the future by going to expensive locations with good future opportunities. In contrast, borrowers transfer resources to the present by going to cheap locations that offer few other advantages. As in a standard portfolio problem, holdings of this asset depend on the comparison of its rate of return with that of other assets. Differently from other assets, the location asset is not subject to borrowing constraints, so it is used by individuals with little or no wealth that want to borrow. We provide an analytical model to make this idea precise and to derive a number of related implications, including an agent's mobility choices after experiencing negative income shocks. The model can rationalize why low wealth individuals locate in low income regions with low opportunities even in the absence of mobility costs. We document the investment dimension of location, and confirm the core predictions of our theory with French individual panel data from tax returns.
abstract_zh: 个体的位置决定了其就业机会、生活便利设施及住房成本。我们认为，将个体的位置选择概念化为对“位置资产”的投资决策是有益的。该资产的成本等于该位置的租金，而其回报则通过更好的就业机会以及可能为个体及其子女带来的人力资本提升来实现。与任何资产一样，位置资产的储蓄者通过前往具有良好未来机会的高成本地区，将资源转移至未来。相反，借款者则通过前往成本低廉且其他优势甚微的地区，将资源转移至当前。如同标准投资组合问题，对该资产的持有取决于其回报率与其他资产回报率的比较。与其他资产不同，位置资产不受借贷约束限制，因此被那些财富极少或没有财富但希望借款的个体所利用。我们提供了一个分析模型来精确阐述这一观点，并推导出若干相关推论，包括个体在遭受负面收入冲击后的流动性选择。该模型能够解释为何低财富个体即使在没有迁移成本的情况下，也会选择位于机会较少的低收入地区。我们记录了位置的投资维度，并通过法国税务申报的个人面板数据验证了我们理论的核心预测。

title: Do Children Derail Women from the CEO Track?
title_zh: 儿童是否会让女性偏离CEO职业轨道？
title_primary: 儿童是否会让女性偏离CEO职业轨道？
title_secondary: Do Children Derail Women from the CEO Track?
authors: Santiago Campos-Rodríguez, David Neumark
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Gender disparities in becoming a CEO are pronounced, and women who become CEOs, especially of large firms, are less likely to have children or be married. We study the effects of children and marriage on becoming a CEO, using longitudinal administrative data covering the universe of tax-registered firms in Costa Rica, matched to universal civil registry records that provide the timing of childbirth and marriage. We find that first childbirth is followed by a persistent decline in women’s probability of becoming a CEO, but no comparable decline for men and some evidence that CEO attainment rises. Marriage displays a different but still divergent pattern: it is associated with higher subsequent CEO attainment for men, but little change for women. Changes around childbirth account for a substantial share of the overall gender difference in CEO rates. Finally, we find evidence consistent with household specialization as a potential mechanism. Around marriage and first childbirth, women’s formal employment, earnings, and share of household earnings decline, while men become more central to household earnings as their partners reduce formal employment.
abstract_zh: 成为CEO的性别差异显著，且成为CEO的女性，尤其是大型企业的女性CEO，更不可能有子女或已婚。我们利用覆盖哥斯达黎加所有税务注册企业的纵向行政数据，并与提供生育和婚姻时间的全民民事登记记录相匹配，研究了子女和婚姻对成为CEO的影响。我们发现，首次生育后，女性成为CEO的概率持续下降，但男性没有类似的下降，且有证据表明男性成为CEO的可能性反而上升。婚姻呈现出不同但仍存在差异的模式：它与男性后续成为CEO的概率提高相关，但对女性几乎没有变化。生育带来的变化在CEO性别差异总体中占据了相当大的份额。最后，我们发现了与家庭专业化作为潜在机制相一致的证据。在婚姻和首次生育前后，女性的正规就业、收入及家庭收入占比下降，而随着伴侣减少正规就业，男性在家庭收入中的核心地位增强。

title: Illbeing Among the Young in Europe: Evidence from the COME HERE Panel
title_zh: 欧洲年轻人的福祉困境：来自COME HERE面板数据的证据
title_primary: 欧洲年轻人的福祉困境：来自COME HERE面板数据的证据
title_secondary: Illbeing Among the Young in Europe: Evidence from the COME HERE Panel
authors: Blanchflower, David, Bryson, Alex, Lepinteur, Anthony, Piper, Alan, Blanchflower, David G.
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: A substantial literature finds poor mental health is hump-shaped with respect to age, whilst subjective wellbeing is U-shaped. Recent cross-sectional studies indicate a change in this relationship driven by the declining mental health of the young. We contribute to this literature by re-examining the age patterns in subjective wellbeing and illbeing for individuals in five European countries (France, Germany, Italy, Spain and Sweden). We do so with fifteen waves of the COME-HERE (CH) panel survey for 2020-2025 plus data from the Global Minds (GM) surveys of 2020-2026 for the same countries. We show that wellbeing rises and illbeing declines in a roughly monotonic fashion with age. This is found both with cross-section data from the CH and GM data, and from longitudinal plots of person fixed effects by age in the CH data.
abstract_zh: 大量文献发现，心理健康状况随年龄呈倒U型分布，而主观幸福感则呈U型分布。近期横截面研究显示，这一关系正发生变化，其驱动因素为年轻人心理健康的下降。我们通过重新考察五个欧洲国家（法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和瑞典）个体主观幸福感与心理困扰的年龄模式，为这一文献领域做出贡献。我们利用2020-2025年十五轮COME-HERE（CH）面板调查数据，以及同一国家2020-2026年Global Minds（GM）调查数据进行分析。研究结果显示，幸福感随年龄大致呈单调上升趋势，而心理困扰则单调下降。这一结论在CH和GM数据的横截面分析中，以及CH数据中按年龄划分的个体固定效应纵向图中均得到验证。

title: When wages rise, quality falls: Minimum wages and the hidden trade-off in competitive e-commerce markets
title_zh: 工资上涨，质量下降：最低工资与竞争性电商市场中的隐性权衡
title_primary: 工资上涨，质量下降：最低工资与竞争性电商市场中的隐性权衡
title_secondary: When wages rise, quality falls: Minimum wages and the hidden trade-off in competitive e-commerce markets
authors: Xinyu Liu, Han Xiao, Songqing Jin
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We show that product and service quality serve as a hidden margin of adjustment to minimum wage hikes in hyper-competitive digital markets. Leveraging granular trans- action data from 2628 Tmall stores in rural China from 2015 to 2020, combined with household surveys and firm-level data, we exploit staggered city-level minimum wage in- creases and find that in the short run, firms neither reduce employment nor significantly raise prices. Instead, they systematically degrade quality, as evidenced by worse product ratings, slower logistics, and poorer customer service, starting within two quarters and per- sisting over time. The reduction in intermediate inputs compromises product quality, while cuts to outsourced IT services undermine service quality by weakening operational effi- ciency. Crucially, this decline is driven by high-quality incumbents, whereas low-quality firms show no change but are more likely to exit the market following the shock. These re- sults reveal a trade-off between labor income and consumer welfare, a cost that is invisible in traditional labor market evaluations but central to a complete welfare assessment.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，在高度竞争的数字市场中，产品和服务质量构成了对最低工资上调的一种隐性调整边际。利用2015年至2020年中国农村2628家天猫店铺的细粒度交易数据，结合家庭调查和企业层面数据，我们利用城市层面最低工资的分阶段上调，发现短期内企业既未减少就业，也未显著提高价格。相反，他们系统性地降低了质量，表现为产品评分下降、物流速度减慢和客户服务变差，这些变化在两个月内开始显现并持续存在。中间投入的减少损害了产品质量，而外包IT服务的削减则通过削弱运营效率损害了服务质量。关键在于，这种下降是由高质量在位企业驱动的，而低质量企业虽无变化，但在冲击后更可能退出市场。这些结果揭示了劳动收入与消费者福利之间的权衡，这一成本在传统劳动力市场评估中不可见，但对于全面的福利评估至关重要。

title: The Effects of Environmental Regulation on FDI: New Evidence From Inward FDI Flows in China
title_zh: 环境规制对外商直接投资的影响：来自中国内向FDI流入的新证据
title_primary: 环境规制对外商直接投资的影响：来自中国内向FDI流入的新证据
title_secondary: The Effects of Environmental Regulation on FDI: New Evidence From Inward FDI Flows in China
authors: Lei Li, Anqi Yu, Tong Zhu, Bocong Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Employing the quasi‐natural experiment of the emission reduction targets of the 11th Five‐Year Plan in 2006, this study investigates the impact of environmental regulation on FDI stocks and flows in China. We find that stringent environmental regulations lead to a “shift” of FDI to less regulated regions due to the “rising cost effect” and “innovation compensation effect”. The effect is prominent for firms with a high capital‐labor ratio, that are state‐owned, in non‐high‐tech or pollution‐intensive sectors. An examination of FDI flows indicates that the observed redirection of FDI is largely driven by foreign investors favouring regions with lenient environmental regulations. Further investigation focusing on parent‐subsidiary relationships reveals that environmental regulations lead to a decrease in the number of subsidiaries established locally by enterprises in regions with stringent regulations. Subsidiaries receive more FDI when the gap in environmental regulation intensity between the location of the parent enterprises and the location of the subsidiaries is larger.
abstract_zh: 本研究以2006年“十一五”规划减排目标为准自然实验，探讨环境规制对中国外商直接投资存量与流量的影响。研究发现，严格的环境规制因“成本上升效应”与“创新补偿效应”导致外商直接投资向规制较宽松地区“转移”。这一效应在资本劳动比高、国有、非高技术或污染密集型行业的企业中尤为显著。对FDI流量的分析表明，观察到的FDI转向主要由外国投资者偏好环境规制宽松地区所驱动。进一步聚焦母子公司关系的研究揭示，环境规制导致规制严格地区企业在本土设立的子公司数量减少。当母公司所在地与子公司所在地的环境规制强度差距越大时，子公司获得的外商直接投资越多。

title: Retail Betting Markets
title_zh: 零售博彩市场
title_primary: 零售博彩市场
title_secondary: Retail Betting Markets
authors: Scott R. Baker, Justin Balthrop, Mark J. Johnson, Jason D. Kotter, Kevin Pisciotta
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the rapid expansion and convergence of retail betting markets. We analyze market design elements, discuss economic utility, and highlight shared behavioral drivers of sports betting markets, prediction markets, and retail options trading. Our review underscores how technological innovation, behavioral biases, and regulatory arbitrage have shaped recent market evolution. We highlight important considerations for policy-makers facing a changing landscape and outline possibilities for further research.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了零售博彩市场的快速扩张与趋同现象。我们分析了市场设计要素，探讨了经济效用，并揭示了体育博彩市场、预测市场与零售期权交易共有的行为驱动因素。本综述强调技术创新、行为偏差与监管套利如何塑造了近期市场演变。我们为面临不断变化格局的政策制定者提出重要考量，并勾勒出未来研究的可能性方向。

title: Beliefs That Predict Returns and Beliefs That Attract Flows: Policy Insights and Sentiment Catering in Mutual Funds
title_zh: 预测回报的信念与吸引资金的信念：共同基金中的政策洞察与情绪迎合
title_primary: 预测回报的信念与吸引资金的信念：共同基金中的政策洞察与情绪迎合
title_secondary: Beliefs That Predict Returns and Beliefs That Attract Flows: Policy Insights and Sentiment Catering in Mutual Funds
authors: Zhenyu Gao, Wei Xiong, Jian Yuan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using mandatory Outlook reports from Chinese mutual funds, we decompose each fund’s equity-market beliefs into macro fundamentals, government policy, and residual sentiment. Policy beliefs, rather than macro beliefs, predict subsequent market returns and help explain the positive alphas observed in China’s mutual fund industry. By contrast, residual sentiment strongly shapes equity allocations and attracts investor flows, even though it does not predict returns. Using maturing wealth management products as an instrument for future aggregate fund flows, we show that funds strategically position their stated beliefs to cater to investors. Overall, our analysis reveals a core tension in active asset management: skilled managers generate performance through policy insights while attracting flows through sentiment alignment.
abstract_zh: 利用中国共同基金的强制性Outlook报告，我们将每只基金的股票市场信念分解为宏观基本面、政府政策和残余情绪。政策信念（而非宏观信念）能够预测后续市场回报，并有助于解释中国共同基金行业观察到的正Alpha。相比之下，残余情绪虽无法预测回报，却显著影响股票配置并吸引投资者资金流入。以即将到期的理财产品作为未来基金总资金流的工具变量，我们发现基金会策略性地调整其陈述的信念以迎合投资者。总体而言，我们的分析揭示了主动资产管理中的核心矛盾：具备技能的基金经理通过政策洞察创造业绩，却需通过情绪迎合来吸引资金流入。

title: DP41 Public Sector Shadow Prices in Distorted General Equilibrium Models
title_zh: 扭曲一般均衡模型中的公共部门影子价格
title_primary: 扭曲一般均衡模型中的公共部门影子价格
title_secondary: DP41 Public Sector Shadow Prices in Distorted General Equilibrium Models
authors: Alasdair Smith
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In a closed competitive general equilibrium constant returns economy, consumer taxes separate consumer and producer prices of goods. Shadow prices appropriate for the evaluation of public sector projects are derived on alternative assumptions about what happens to taxes as public production changes. In some examples, equilibrium prices and shadow prices are computed, and these computations suggest both that shadow prices are quite sensitive to the precise specification of pre-existing distortions and also that partial equilibrium intuition about the relation between shadow prices and market prices may be seriously misleading. The possibility of extending the analysis to more realistic examples and models is discussed.
abstract_zh: 在封闭竞争性一般均衡的规模报酬不变经济中，消费税将商品的消费者价格与生产者价格分离。基于公共生产变化时税收调整的不同假设，推导出适用于公共部门项目评估的影子价格。通过若干算例计算均衡价格与影子价格，结果表明：影子价格对既有扭曲的具体设定高度敏感，且关于影子价格与市场价格关系的局部均衡直觉可能产生严重误导。本文进一步探讨了将该分析拓展至更现实案例与模型的可能性。

title: Corporate Earnings Announcements and Stock Market Bubbles
title_zh: 企业盈利公告与股市泡沫
title_primary: 企业盈利公告与股市泡沫
title_secondary: Corporate Earnings Announcements and Stock Market Bubbles
authors: Elie Bouri, Ufuk Can, Oğuzhan Çepni, Rangan Gupta
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine how corporate earnings announcement shocks influence US stock market bubbles using daily data from January 1990 to June 2025. After identifying positive and negative bubbles, we derive corporate earnings announcement shocks using a heteroskedastic vector autoregression model and estimate their dynamic effects on bubble indicators using local projections, with vector autoregression-based impulse responses reported as a robustness check. Positive earnings shocks boost positive bubbles, particularly at the medium to long-term, while reducing negative bubbles at the short-term. Therefore, favorable earnings news can fuel prolonged speculative episodes by increasing investor optimism, and lead to deep crashes but mild recoveries.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1990年1月至2025年6月的日度数据，考察了企业盈利公告冲击如何影响美国股市泡沫。在识别出正向和负向泡沫后，我们采用异方差向量自回归模型推导企业盈利公告冲击，并通过局部投影法估计其对泡沫指标的动态效应，同时以基于向量自回归的脉冲响应作为稳健性检验。正向盈利冲击会增强正向泡沫，尤其在中期至长期内效果显著，同时短期内会减弱负向泡沫。因此，利好的盈利消息可能通过提升投资者乐观情绪，助长长期投机行为，并导致深度崩盘但温和复苏。

title: Regularization and the Formation of Social Capital: Evidence from Forced Migrants in Colombia
title_zh: 正规化与社会资本的形成：来自哥伦比亚强制移民的证据
title_primary: 正规化与社会资本的形成：来自哥伦比亚强制移民的证据
title_secondary: Regularization and the Formation of Social Capital: Evidence from Forced Migrants in Colombia
authors: Rozo, Sandra V.
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers

abstract: This paper estimates the medium-run effects, 4.5 years after launch, of a regularization program that granted temporary legal status, freedom of movement, work authorization, and access to social programs to nearly half a million Venezuelan forced migrants in Colombia with no criminal record. Because the program was announced unexpectedly and applied retroactively to migrants who had registered in a census before a sharp eligibility cutoff, the paper identifies its effects using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design and a unique two-wave panel survey. The largest medium-run gains were in social capital. At the cutoff, eligible migrants scored 0.95 standard deviation higher than ineligible peers on a social integration index capturing belonging, friendships with Colombians, community participation, and attachment to Colombia, and 0.97 standard deviation higher on a prosocial behavior index measuring generalized trust and trust toward both Colombians and Venezuelans. Neither effect is detectable in the short run, and both emerge only over time. Economic gains, by contrast, arose immediately and largely persisted. Eligible migrants earned 69 percent higher monthly labor income, scored 2.6 standard deviations higher on a service access index, and made substantial investments in housing, with housing quality increasing from 0.60 to 1.27 standard deviations between survey waves. The implied fiscal savings to Colombia also increased over time, rising from roughly 40 to 70 percent of the fiscal cost associated with irregular households as beneficiaries moved toward fiscal balance. These findings suggest that the largest social capital and fiscal returns to regularization accrued gradually through sustained legal inclusion and repeated positive interactions with institutions and host communities rather than through the act of legalization itself.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了一项合法化计划在启动四年半后的中期效应。该计划向近50万在哥伦比亚无犯罪记录的委内瑞拉被迫移民授予临时合法身份、自由迁徙权、工作许可及社会项目准入资格。由于该计划系突然宣布，且对在严格资格截止日期前完成人口普查登记的移民具有追溯效力，本文利用模糊断点回归设计及独特的两轮面板调查数据识别其影响。中期最大收益体现在社会资本领域：在断点处，符合资格的移民在社会融合指数（涵盖归属感、与哥伦比亚人的友谊、社区参与及对哥伦比亚的依恋）上得分比不符合资格的同伴高0.95个标准差，在亲社会行为指数（衡量普遍信任及对哥伦比亚人与委内瑞拉人的信任）上得分高0.97个标准差。这两种效应在短期内均不可观测，且随时间推移才逐渐显现。相比之下，经济收益则立即产生并基本持续：符合资格的移民月劳动收入高出69%，服务获取指数得分高出2.6个标准差，并在住房方面进行大量投资，住房质量在两轮调查间从0.60个标准差提升至1.27个标准差。哥伦比亚的隐含财政节约也随时间增长，随着受益者逐步实现财政平衡，从约占非正规家庭相关财政成本的40%上升至70%。这些发现表明，合法化带来的最大社会资本与财政回报是通过持续的法律包容及与制度、东道社区的反复积极互动逐步累积的，而非源于合法化行为本身。

abstract: This paper studies the merits of policy rules with escape clauses, analysing as an example fixed exchange rate systems that allow member countries the freedom to realign in periods of stress. Motivating this example is the debate within the European Monetary System over how quickly to move from the current regime of national currencies, linked by pegged but adjustable exchange rates, to a single European currency. The paper's main point is that while well-designed rules with escape clauses can raise society's welfare in principle, limited credibility makes it difficult for governments to implement such rules in practice. An EMS-type institution which presumably imposes a political cost on policy-makers who realign may lead to an optimal escape-clause equilibrium, but may just as well lead to alternative equilibria far inferior to an irrevocably fixed exchange rate. Countries can suffer periods in which no realignment occurs, yet unemployment, real wages, and ex post real interest rates remain persistently and sub-optimally high.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了带有例外条款的政策规则的优劣，并以允许成员国在压力时期自由调整汇率的固定汇率制度为例进行分析。这一例子的动机源于欧洲货币体系内部关于应从当前由可调整钉住汇率联结的国家货币体系，以多快速度过渡到单一欧洲货币的争论。本文的核心观点是：尽管设计良好的例外条款规则在理论上能够提升社会福利，但有限的可信度使得政府在实践中难以实施此类规则。一个类似欧洲货币体系的制度安排，若对进行汇率调整的政策制定者施加政治成本，可能会产生最优的例外条款均衡，但也同样可能导致远不如不可撤销的固定汇率制度的替代均衡。各国可能经历无汇率调整的时期，但失业率、实际工资以及事后实际利率却持续处于次优的高位。

abstract: This paper provides new evidence of local protectionism by examining government information disclosure and suggests that public information reporting may serve as a potential channel through which governments favor local firms. Focusing on China’s food safety information disclosure, we compare food safety testing results conducted by local and national administrations for the same product within the same manufacturer and year. Our findings reveal a significantly lower probability of failure in food safety tests conducted by the local prefectural administration, holding across model specifications, accounting for different fixed effects, collusions between manufacturers and independent inspection agencies, technical differences in testing between administrations and the impact of the pandemic. Food manufacturing firms with higher registration capital and those strategic to local economies show lower probability of failure reported by local administrations, particularly in regions with aggressive GDP growth targets. This implies competition among regional governments drives a local bias in public information reporting, undermining the accuracy and transparency of food safety disclosure.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察政府信息公开提供了地方保护主义的新证据，并指出公共信息报告可能是政府偏袒本地企业的一个潜在渠道。聚焦于中国的食品安全信息公开，我们比较了同一制造商、同一年度内地方与国家行政机构对同一产品进行的食品安全检测结果。研究发现，地方市级行政机构进行的食品安全检测不合格概率显著较低，这一结论在多种模型设定下稳健，包括考虑不同的固定效应、制造商与独立检测机构之间的合谋、行政机构间检测技术差异以及疫情的影响。注册资本较高及对地方经济具有战略意义的食品制造企业，在地方行政机构报告中的不合格概率更低，尤其是在GDP增长目标激进的地区。这表明地方政府间的竞争导致了公共信息报告中的本地偏向，削弱了食品安全信息披露的准确性和透明度。

abstract: Black workers experience higher, more volatile unemployment than white workers, a racial dis- parity unexplained by observables. A New Keynesian model with a frictional labor market, endogenous separations, and employer discrimination explains these outcomes. We use the model to assess how alternative monetary policy strategies affect labor market outcomes by race. Switching to a monetary policy rule where interest rates respond to shortfalls of employment from its maximum level instead of deviations raises inflation and does not reduce the racial unemployment gap. A monetary policy rule where interest rates respond to the racial unemployment gap also fails to reduce the gap.

abstract: Climate-driven displacement is widely expected to push millions across international borders. Drawing on monthly bilateral flows for 127 developing-country origins, this column finds the reverse: a temperature shock reduces emigration rather than raising it, because climate stress cuts origin incomes and poor households cannot finance a costly international move. On this evidence, the ‘climate refugee’ is the exception, and hardship more often traps poor populations in place than sets them moving.
abstract_zh: 气候驱动的流离失所现象被广泛预期将推动数百万人跨越国际边界。本文基于127个发展中国家来源地的月度双边人口流动数据，发现了相反的结果：温度冲击反而减少了移民数量，而非增加移民数量，原因是气候压力降低了来源地收入，贫困家庭无力承担高昂的国际迁移成本。基于这一证据，"气候难民"属于例外情况，而困境更常使贫困人口困在原地，而非促使他们迁移。

title: “Friend-shoring” and global supply chains: Empirical evidence from the semiconductor industry
title_zh: 友岸外包”与全球供应链：来自半导体行业的经验证据
title_primary: 友岸外包”与全球供应链：来自半导体行业的经验证据

authors: Yanyun Li, Faqin Lin, Kaiyue Yang, Qianqian Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Drawing on U.S. global trade data from 2015 to 2023, this study empirically examines the impact of the “friend-shoring” policy on semiconductor supply chain dynamics. The analysis reveals that a one-standard-deviation improvement in bilateral political relations is associated with a 0.28 percentage point increase in the U.S. import share of semiconductors from politically aligned countries. Supply chain realignment shows considerable heterogeneity: trade in raw materials and finished components has shifted toward politically aligned partners, whereas manufacturing equipment shows weaker responsiveness due to efficiency considerations and supply-side constraints. The policy has introduced a “security premium” in import prices, especially for manufacturing equipment and imports from upper-middle-income politically aligned partners. Despite U.S. efforts to reduce dependence on China, products with high reliance on Chinese sources show no substantial disruption. Moreover, allied countries have not experienced a significant increase in their export shares to the U.S. market, while China’s semiconductor exports to U.S. allies have continued to expand. These findings indicate that the friend-shoring has led to only limited restructuring within semiconductor supply chains and has not materially altered existing dependency patterns.
abstract_zh: 基于2015至2023年美国全球贸易数据，本研究实证考察了“友岸外包”政策对半导体供应链动态的影响。分析显示，双边政治关系每提升一个标准差，美国从政治盟友国家进口半导体的份额将增加0.28个百分点。供应链重构呈现出显著的异质性：原材料和成品组件的贸易已转向政治盟友伙伴，而制造设备因效率考量及供给侧约束，其响应程度相对较弱。该政策在进口价格中引入了“安全溢价”，尤其体现在制造设备及来自中高收入政治盟友伙伴的进口上。尽管美国致力于减少对中国的依赖，但对华高度依赖的产品并未出现实质性中断。此外，盟友国家在美国市场的出口份额并未显著增长，而中国对美盟友的半导体出口则持续扩大。这些发现表明，友岸外包仅促成半导体供应链的有限重组，并未实质性改变现有的依赖格局。

title: A Tale of Two Market Returns: The Broad Market Factor and The Idiosyncratic Financial Factor

title_primary: 两种市场收益的故事：广泛市场因子与特质金融因子

authors: Byun, Sung Je, Loudis, Johnathan, Schmidt, Lawrence, Schmidt, Lawrence David Warren
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We construct a Broad Market Factor (BMF), which is a proxy for the value-weighted equity return on all firms in the US economy (public and private). The BMF differs from the standard Value-weighted Market Factor (VMF), which reflects the value-weighted equity return on public firms. We define the difference between the VMF and the BMF to be the Idiosyncratic Financial Factor (IFF). The IFF carries no risk premium and is uncorrelated with all macroeconomic proxies for investor marginal utility we consider. CAPM betas and, consequently, discount rates are underestimated when measured with respect to the VMF compared to the BMF for most portfolios. Size factors become redundant and the size anomaly is resolved when the VMF is replaced by the BMF in standard factor models. The intertemporal risk-return relation is substantially stronger when one replaces the VMF with the BMF. The unifying explanation for these results is that the IFF adds unpriced risk to the VMF, distorting both cross-sectional and time-series estimates of exposure to priced market risk.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个广义市场因子（BMF），用以代表美国经济中所有企业（包括上市公司与非上市公司）的价值加权股权回报。BMF与标准价值加权市场因子（VMF）存在差异，后者仅反映上市公司的价值加权股权回报。我们将VMF与BMF之间的差值定义为特质金融因子（IFF）。该IFF不包含风险溢价，且与我们考虑的所有投资者边际效用宏观经济代理变量均不相关。对于大多数投资组合而言，相较于基于BMF的测算，基于VMF的CAPM贝塔值及由此得出的贴现率均被低估。当标准因子模型中的VMF被BMF替代时，规模因子变得冗余，规模异象得以消除。用BMF替代VMF后，跨期风险-收益关系显著增强。这些结果的统一解释是：IFF为VMF增加了未定价风险，从而扭曲了横截面与时间序列上对定价市场风险暴露程度的估计。

abstract: This paper examines whether military service can promote intergenerational mobility in developing countries. We use survey data from 3037 men exposed to conscription to compare respondents’ socioeconomic and educational outcomes with those of their parents. Exploiting the random assignment of conscription by lottery, we show that serving increases upward mobility for individuals from low-SES backgrounds, with no effects for those from more privileged ones. The positive effects of military service on mobility disappear under non-democratic regimes or wartime, underscoring the importance of stable institutional contexts for the military to enhance mobility.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在发展中国家，兵役能否促进代际流动性。我们利用3037名受征兵制度影响的男性调查数据，将受访者的社会经济和教育成果与其父母进行比较。借助征兵抽签的随机分配机制，我们发现，对于来自低社会经济地位背景的个体，服役能提升其向上流动性，而对来自更优越背景的个体则无影响。然而，在非民主政权或战争时期，兵役对流动性的积极影响消失，这凸显了稳定的制度环境对于军队促进流动性的重要性。

title: Clearing the Air: How Fine Particulate Matter Regulations Reshape Farmland Values in U.S. Corn and Soybean Regions
title_zh: 净化空气：细颗粒物法规如何重塑美国玉米和大豆产区的农田价值
title_primary: 净化空气：细颗粒物法规如何重塑美国玉米和大豆产区的农田价值

authors: Cécile Couharde, Rémi Generoso
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate the impact of air quality regulations targeting fine particulate matter (PM 2.5 ) on farmland values in corn and soybean producing counties in the United States over the period 1997–2022. Using self‐reported farmland value data from the Agricultural Census and county‐level pollution classifications provided by the Environmental Protection Agency, we employ a difference‐in‐differences event‐study design—incorporating inverse probability weighting and doubly robust estimators—to estimate the causal effect of regulatory interventions. Our primary analysis contrasts ‘non‐attainment’ counties, which failed to meet the National Ambient Air Quality Standards for PM 2.5 , with those that consistently maintained compliance. We further assess heterogeneous treatment effects by extending our analysis with a triple‐difference specification comparing counties with high versus low fertiliser use. Additionally, we employ the recentered influence function to conduct an unconditional quantile analysis across the entire distribution of farmland values. Our estimates indicate an 8.80%–8.94% decline in farmland values in ‘non‐attainment’ counties in response to the enforcement of PM 2.5 standards, suggesting that the economic costs of the prescribed standards were capitalised into farmland values, particularly in regions with higher fertiliser use. However, this impact was not uniform, with more pronounced effects observed among counties at the lower end of the farmland value distribution.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了针对细颗粒物（PM2.5）的空气质量管理法规对美国玉米和大豆生产县农田价值的影响，时间跨度为1997年至2022年。利用农业普查中自报的农田价值数据以及环境保护局提供的县级污染分类，我们采用双重差分事件研究设计——结合逆概率加权和双稳健估计量——来评估监管干预的因果效应。我们的主要分析对比了未达到国家环境空气质量标准中PM2.5要求的“未达标”县与持续保持合规的县。通过扩展分析，我们采用三重差分规格，比较高化肥使用县与低化肥使用县，进一步评估异质性处理效应。此外，我们运用再中心化影响函数，对农田价值全分布进行无条件分位数分析。我们的估计显示，在PM2.5标准执行后，“未达标”县的农田价值下降了8.80%至8.94%，这表明规定标准的经济成本已资本化到农田价值中，尤其是在化肥使用量较高的地区。然而，这一影响并非均匀分布，在农田价值分布较低端的县中观察到了更为显著的效果。

abstract: This paper uncovers that input tariff reductions result in less domestic innovation, but standard models of trade ensure a positive correlation between importing and innovation. Hence, the paper develops a dynamic framework with a task-specific laboraugmenting productivity and a non-homothetic import demand system to rationalize this finding. The model implies that input liberalization enables firms to use cheaper intermediate imports as a substitute for self-made inputs, a strategy that decreases marginal production costs but also discourages firms from investing in their own inhouse varieties. Finally, the paper compares the effectiveness of trade and innovation policies in boosting aggregate productivity growth.
abstract_zh: 本文发现，投入品关税削减导致国内创新减少，而标准贸易模型却认为进口与创新之间存在正相关关系。为此，本文构建了一个包含任务特定劳动增强型生产率与非同质进口需求体系的动态框架，以解释这一发现。模型表明，投入品自由化使企业能够用更便宜的进口中间品替代自制投入品，这一策略虽降低了边际生产成本，但也抑制了企业对自主开发内部品种的投资。最后，本文比较了贸易政策与创新政策在促进全要素生产率增长方面的有效性。

title: Trade models, trade elasticities, and the gains from trade
title_zh: 贸易模型、贸易弹性与贸易收益
title_primary: 贸易模型、贸易弹性与贸易收益
title_secondary: Trade models, trade elasticities, and the gains from trade
authors: Ina Simonovska, Michael E. Waugh
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We consider five models of international trade that belong to the class of models in which the trade elasticity and domestic trade share are sufficient statistics for the welfare cost of autarky. Three are fixed-variety models featuring increasing micro-level margins of adjustment: versions of the Armington model, the Ricardian model, and its variable-markup counterpart. Two are endogenous-variety models featuring monopolistic competition: versions of the Krugman model and the Melitz model. For the three fixed-variety models, we show theoretically that, although they imply the same mapping from the trade elasticity to welfare, they imply different mappings from the trade elasticity to observed order statistics of price gaps of identical goods across countries. This result implies that choosing the parameter that governs the elasticity of trade to match the same order statistics in the data differentially impacts each model’s measured welfare cost of autarky. We quantify these differences for all five models.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了五类国际贸易模型，这些模型均属于贸易弹性与国内贸易份额足以衡量自给自足福利成本的模型类别。其中三个为固定品种模型，体现了微观层面调整边际的递增：包括阿明顿模型、李嘉图模型及其可变加成变体。另外两个为内生品种模型，采用垄断竞争框架：即克鲁格曼模型和梅利茨模型。对于三个固定品种模型，我们从理论上证明，尽管它们从贸易弹性到福利的映射相同，但从贸易弹性到跨国同质商品价格差距观测顺序统计量的映射却各不相同。这一结果表明，为使贸易弹性参数与数据中的相同顺序统计量相匹配而进行的参数选择，会差异化地影响各模型测得的自给自足福利成本。我们对所有五个模型的这些差异进行了量化分析。

title: Farmers' pro‐social motivations and willingness‐to‐accept in markets with public goods
title_zh: 农民亲社会动机与公共品市场中的接受意愿
title_primary: 农民亲社会动机与公共品市场中的接受意愿

authors: Jill Fitzsimmons, Hikaru Hanawa Peterson, Nathalie Lavoie
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To explain how some farmers' decisions may diverge from profit-maximization, we incorporate proactive social preferences for public goods in an expected utility framework, in addition to reactive risk preferences to uncertainty. We offer empirical evidence that proactive preferences influence farmers' decisions alongside reactive preferences by combining a discrete choice experiment, a dictator game, and the Eckle Grossman risk elicitation method. In our application, farmers choose between selling to origin-identified (OI) markets, which may provide public goods but involve uncertainty, and to wholesale markets, which offer certainty but do not provide public goods. Farmers are heterogeneous in their valuation of OI markets, but, on average, are willing to accept loss in profit to sell to OI markets. This willingness-to-accept is partially explained by farmers' social preferences, even when controlling for risk preferences. Our results show that when evaluating policies, failure to consider either social or risk preferences leads to considerably different outcomes. To increase sales through OI markets and support the perceived associated public goods, policymakers could leverage farmers' preferences for these markets with carefully designed incentives.
abstract_zh: 为解释部分农户决策为何可能偏离利润最大化目标，我们在期望效用框架中引入了对公共物品的主动性社会偏好，同时纳入对不确定性的反应性风险偏好。通过结合离散选择实验、独裁者博弈以及Eckel-Grossman风险诱导方法，我们提供了实证证据，表明主动性偏好与反应性偏好共同影响农户决策。在我们的应用中，农户需在销售给产地标识（OI）市场与批发市场之间做出选择：前者可能提供公共物品但伴随不确定性，后者则提供确定性但不涉及公共物品。农户对OI市场的估值存在异质性，但平均而言，他们愿意接受利润损失以销售至OI市场。即便在控制风险偏好的情况下，这种接受意愿部分可由农户的社会偏好解释。研究结果表明，在政策评估中，若忽视社会偏好或风险偏好中的任一因素，将导致截然不同的结果。为通过OI市场增加销售并支持其所关联的公共物品，政策制定者可借助精心设计的激励措施，利用农户对这些市场的偏好。

title: A Theory of Front-Line Management

abstract: Mid- and low-level managers play a significant role within the organizational hierarchy, far beyond monitoring. It is often their responsibility to respond to opportunities and threats within their units by adjusting their subordinates’ assignments. Most such managers, however, lack the authority to adapt their subordinates’ wages. Instead, they rely on other, more restrictive incentive schemes. We study the interaction between a front-line manager and worker and characterize the “managerial style” as a function of the players’ relative patience and information. title: Administrative Capacity in Public Procurement: Evidence and Mechanisms
title_zh: 公共采购中的行政能力：证据与机制

authors: Audinga Baltrunaite, Sauro Mocetti, Gabriele Rovigatti
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates the role of administrative capacity in shaping procurement outcomes using rich Italian data on public works. We analyse the duration of the three main phases – planning, awarding, and execution – for observationally equivalent projects. First, we document substantial heterogeneity across contracting authorities: their fixed effects account for a sizeable share of the variation in procurement length, and delays tend to persist across all phases, pointing to structural differences in organizational capacity. These differences are strongly correlated with indicators of administrative quality. Second, we show that the identity of the procurement manager (RUP) matters, even within the same organization. Observable characteristics such as education or tenure explain only a limited fraction of the variation, highlighting the importance of unobservable factors such as tacit knowledge, effort, and managerial skills. Third, in the execution phase, both procuring authorities and firms play a crucial role: execution times are shorter when projects are awarded to more productive firms, and higher-ability managers are more likely to select such firms.
abstract_zh: 本文利用意大利公共工程的丰富数据，探究行政能力对采购结果的影响。我们分析了观察等价项目的三个主要阶段——规划、招标与执行——的持续时间。首先，我们记录了签约机构之间存在显著的异质性：其固定效应解释了采购时长变异的相当大一部分，且延误往往在所有阶段持续存在，这表明组织能力存在结构性差异。这些差异与行政质量指标高度相关。其次，我们证明采购经理（RUP）的身份至关重要，即使在同一个组织内部也是如此。教育背景或任职年限等可观测特征仅能解释有限比例的变异，这凸显了隐性知识、努力程度和管理技能等不可观测因素的重要性。第三，在执行阶段，采购机构与企业均发挥关键作用：当项目被授予生产率更高的企业时，执行时间更短，而能力更强的经理更倾向于选择此类企业。

title: If you extend it, they will come: the effects of the STEM OPT extension

authors: Pauline Khoo
official: 官方在线 2025-09-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper evaluates the effect of the Optional Practical Training (OPT) programme extension for international STEM graduates on major choice in the United States. The OPT programme permits international graduates to work in the U.S. while maintaining student-visa status, and the length of time allowed to work in the U.S. was significantly extended in 2008 for STEM graduates. Despite its wide use, the effect of the OPT extension on enrolment patterns remains underexplored and the analysis in this paper adds important and novel evidence on this issue. The empirical approach is based on a difference-in-differences research design, and the data for the analysis are from administrative data on student enrolment at all public universities in the state of Ohio. Estimates indicate that the OPT extension increased the likelihood of international students’ enrolment in OPT-eligible STEM fields by 19% among undergraduate students and 45% among Master’s students. Additional analyses of the effect of OPT extension on student quality and degree completion revealed a small increase in average GPAs along with approximately a 33% increase in 5- to 7-year completion rates for Bachelor’s degrees and a 50% increase in 3- to 4-year completion rates for Master’s degrees in OPT-eligible STEM fields.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了选择性实习训练（OPT）项目对国际STEM毕业生在美国专业选择的影响。OPT项目允许国际毕业生在维持学生签证身份期间在美国工作，而2008年STEM毕业生的在美工作许可期限被显著延长。尽管该项目被广泛使用，但OPT延期对入学模式的影响仍鲜有探讨，本文的分析为此问题提供了重要且新颖的证据。实证方法基于双重差分研究设计，分析数据来自俄亥俄州所有公立大学的学生入学行政记录。估计结果显示，OPT延期使国际学生就读OPT合格STEM领域的概率在本科生中提高了19%，在硕士生中提高了45%。进一步分析OPT延期对学生质量和学位完成情况的影响发现，在OPT合格STEM领域，平均绩点略有上升，同时学士学位5至7年完成率提高了约33%，硕士学位3至4年完成率提高了50%。

title: Gender Homophily, Collaboration, and Output
title_zh: 性别同质性、合作与产出
title_primary: 性别同质性、合作与产出
title_secondary: Gender Homophily, Collaboration, and Output
authors: Lorenzo Ductor, Anja Prummer, Samuel Bazzi
official: 官方在线 2023-04-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We consider the implications of gender homophily in Economics, which has persisted despite the significant increase in women in the field. As women remain underrepresented, gender homophily may serve as a constraint in collaboration. It could also lead to less gender diverse co-author teams than may be optimal in terms of generating high quality research papers. We show that gender homophily neither constrains collaboration nor prevents higher quality output. This implies that a mere increase in women in Economics will not be sufficient to erase existing gender inequalities.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了经济学中性别同质性的影响，尽管该领域女性人数显著增加，但性别同质性现象依然持续存在。由于女性仍处于代表性不足的状态，性别同质性可能成为合作中的制约因素。此外，它可能导致合著团队的性别多样性低于产出高质量研究论文的最优水平。我们证明，性别同质性既不会限制合作，也不会阻碍更高质量成果的产生。这意味着，仅靠增加经济学领域的女性人数并不足以消除现有的性别不平等现象。
